rics.description: Bankruptcy filings (3 months ending), business, total
rics.meaning: Business bankruptcy filings, 3-month rolling. From AOUSC.
rics.how_to_use: Trailing indicator. Spikes during recessions. Watch alongside delinquency rates and tightening lending standards.

rics.description: Bankruptcy filings (3 months ending), non-business, total
rics.meaning: Non-business (consumer) bankruptcy filings, 3-month rolling.
rics.how_to_use: Rises with consumer debt distress. Healthcare costs and divorce historically the dominant drivers.

rics.description: Bankruptcy filings (3 months ending), total
rics.meaning: Total US bankruptcy filings — sum of business and non-business (consumer) Chapter 7, 11, and 13 filings. Released quarterly by the Administrative Office of the US Courts.
rics.how_to_use: Cyclical late-cycle stress signal. Spikes when consumer credit delinquencies and business defaults pick up — typically lags labor weakness by 6-9 months. The 2005 BAPCPA reform created a structural break; pre-2005 levels not directly comparable to post-2005.

rics.description: Commercial Banks, Applicable income taxes
rics.meaning: Commercial Banks: Applicable income taxes — federal + state taxes paid by US commercial banks. FDIC quarterly Call Report.
rics.how_to_use: Tracks bank profitability after tax. Useful for ROE calculations and post-tax-reform impact analysis (2017 TCJA cut bank effective tax rates from ~28% to ~21%). Bank earnings trends visible here lag pretax income.

rics.description: Commercial Banks, interest income
rics.meaning: Commercial banks, total interest income.
rics.how_to_use: Surged 2022-23 with rate hikes. Watch alongside interest expense for NIM trend.

rics.description: Commercial banks, interest expense
rics.meaning: Commercial banks, total interest expense.
rics.how_to_use: Lagged the rate cycle (deposit betas). Compresses NIM when finally repricing.

rics.description: Commercial banks, net income
rics.meaning: Commercial banks, net income (after tax).
rics.how_to_use: Aggregate banking system bottom line. Highly cyclical; watch ROE/ROA for normalized health.

rics.description: Commercial banks, net interest income
rics.meaning: Commercial banks, net interest income.
rics.how_to_use: Core banking earnings = interest income − interest expense. The biggest swing factor in bank profitability.

rics.description: Commercial banks, non-interest expense
rics.meaning: Commercial banks, non-interest expense (compensation, occupancy, tech, etc).
rics.how_to_use: Efficiency ratio (non-int exp / revenue) is a key metric. ~55-60% is healthy for large banks.

rics.description: Commercial banks, non-interest income
rics.meaning: Commercial banks, non-interest income (fees, trading, mortgage banking, advisory).
rics.how_to_use: More volatile than NII. Helps diversify earnings; surged with capital markets activity.

rics.description: Commercial banks, number of institutions
rics.meaning: Commercial banks, number of institutions.
rics.how_to_use: Long-term decline (4,500+ in 2010 to ~4,000 today) from M&A and failures. Concentration is rising.

rics.description: Commercial banks, pre-tax net operating income
rics.meaning: Commercial banks, pre-tax net operating income.
rics.how_to_use: Strips out tax effects. Cleaner operating-performance read than after-tax net income.

rics.description: Commercial banks, provision for loan & lease losses
rics.meaning: Commercial banks, provision for loan and lease losses.
rics.how_to_use: Counter-cyclical: rises sharply going into recessions. CECL accounting now front-loads provisions.

rics.description: Commercial banks, securities gains/losses
rics.meaning: Commercial banks, securities gains/losses.
rics.how_to_use: Realized gains/losses on bond holdings. Big losses in 2022 from rising rates (HTM avoided realization).

rics.description: Assets and liab of cml banks, commercial & industrial
rics.meaning: Commercial and Industrial loans outstanding at commercial banks (Fed H.8). Business credit cycle gauge.
rics.how_to_use: Slows ahead of recessions; SLOOS lending standards typically lead loan-volume slowdowns by 1-2 quarters. Currently flat-ish — banks tightened standards 2023-24 in response to deposit competition + CRE worries.

rics.description: Assets and liab of cml banks, consumer
rics.meaning: Consumer loans outstanding at commercial banks — credit cards + auto + other consumer (excluding real estate). Different from aUSCRDOUTA (G.19) which captures ALL consumer credit issuers.
rics.how_to_use: Banks are ~50% of the consumer credit market. Watch alongside G.19 total to gauge shadow-bank vs bank shifts. Credit unions + finance companies + securitization pools complete the picture.

rics.description: Assets and liab of cml banks, other loans and leases
rics.meaning: Commercial Banks: Other loans and leases — non-traditional lending categories (lease financing, acceptances, agricultural production loans).
rics.how_to_use: Smaller than C&I, real estate, or consumer loan books. Useful for tracking lease-finance trends (declining as direct lending replaces leasing) and for full bank-credit picture.

rics.description: Assets and liab of cml banks, real estate
rics.meaning: Real Estate loans outstanding at commercial banks — residential mortgages + CRE. Largest single bank loan category.
rics.how_to_use: CRE stress concentrated in regional banks (large banks cleaner). Office sector weighs on aggregate; multifamily + industrial healthier. Watch SLOOS for CRE tightening signals.

rics.description: IFDI, Financial Performance Indicator, Islamic Banking, Full Fledged Banks
rics.meaning: IFDI Financial Performance, Islamic Banking, Full-Fledged Banks (US data).
rics.how_to_use: Niche — Islamic Finance Development Indicator. US has few full-fledged Islamic banks; data is thin.
